WebhookAckResponse.description:
Conceptual acknowledgement shape for a successfully handled webhook.

Documentation only: both webhook routes actually return an empty ``200``/``204``-style
``Response`` with no body, so this model never gets serialized at runtime. It is attached as
``response_model`` so the OpenAPI schema and Swagger UI show integrators what "success" means.

APIKeyHeader.description: Shared secret configured via the BLUEBUBBLES_WEBHOOK_TOKEN environment variable. Compared with a constant-time equality check when a token is configured; if none is configured the endpoint accepts requests without this header.
APIKeyHeader.name: X-Webhook-Token

info.description: Regulars simulates the conversation, then checks it against what happened at dinner. This service is the web entrypoint: it receives Stripe payment webhooks and BlueBubbles (iMessage) inbound-message webhooks, and exposes a health check.
info.title: Regulars

get.description: Returns 200 with a static body whenever the process is up and able to serve requests.

post.description: Hands the raw JSON body straight through to the configured `InboundSink`; no parsing happens here (`regulars.features.ingest` and the bot own the BlueBubbles shape). When `BLUEBUBBLES_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` is set, the request must carry the same value in `X-Webhook-Token` (compared with a constant-time equality check); when it is unset the endpoint accepts requests without that header. Never logs the request body: it may carry message text. Handler exceptions propagate as 500s so BlueBubbles retries the delivery.

400.description: Body is missing, not JSON, or not a JSON object.

401.description: X-Webhook-Token missing or does not match.

post.description: Verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header against the raw request body with `StripeDeposits.verify_webhook`, then hands the resulting `StripeEvent` to the configured `PaymentEventSink`. Never logs the request body: it may carry card details. Handler exceptions other than a bad signature propagate as 500s so Stripe retries the delivery.
